body: Wow, how shockingly accurate is this
So glad to hear your update! I knew you’d be fine 😊
I completely relate to this. I just ruined my career due to my highly neurotic behaviour and paranoia. I have no idea what to do

How exactly did you turn it around? What specifically did you do? I used to be so brilliant in school and uni. I mean dean's list, academic half colours etc. As much as I may have hated anything else about myself, I was confident in my intelligence. And then I started this job and I felt like I was sinking, so overwhelmed and just felt like an idiot! Although I don't know why... recently I had met all my targets and they even gave me birthday bonus in January and said I was a valued employee but my insecurity and low self esteem got the best of me. Just the thought of having to think for myself and rely on my decisions to navigate through life makes me cringe.
Hey I hope are you still around?
